title: 第13章 十八祖现身神子的人气超旺噢第14章 签到法天象地大神通
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: 一道青色刀光划破长空，斩开黑暗，让君傲天，林琅天两人和一雕，逃离了那一片黑暗虚空。
“君傲天见过十八祖”
看见面前出现一道气势宏大，气息强横，手执大关刀，怒气冲冲的青袍老者，君傲天连忙行礼。
“林琅天见过十八祖”林琅天也是有样学样，没办法，人多礼不怪嘛。
“嗯，傲天你小子没事吧”青袍老者斜瞄一眼君傲天。
“十八老祖，我没事，不过不知道是谁出手拦截我们”。
看见君傲天一副气定神闲的样子，十八祖也是放心下来了。
“出手之人是十绝门的人，能请动杀手组织，派准帝杀你，傲天小子，看来你面子挺大的”
青袍老者一副戏谑的表情。
“还好老祖及时赶来，不然我们就危险了，十绝门的人呢？”君傲天向十八祖表示感激。
“身为杀手，一击之后，情况不对，自然是退走了，不过还没有谁能够在君家地盘上，动君家人能安然无恙的，不过这就不用你操心了”
“你就是林家小子？”十八神眼神如电，盯着林琅天。
“晚辈林琅天见过十八祖”虽然准帝气势滔天，汹涌澎湃，但林琅天也是稳如泰山，不卑不亢。
“喔，小子虽然你现在很废物，但凭你这份心境，来日也必有一番作为”。
青袍老者眼带赞赏；
“谢过十八祖夸奖，晚辈愧不敢当”林琅天装出一副谦虚模样。
“好了，一切回到君家再说，由我带你们回君家吧”
十八祖大关刀随身一划，面前的虚空如遭巨力撕裂，接着十八祖随手一拂，两人一雕随着青袍老者，消失在虚空中。
中天道域核心，君家，齐天宫，寓意着君家与天比高的决心，不愧是响彻天荒，声震八荒的君家。
十八祖带着两人一雕回到君家，就消失不见，林琅天看着道则遍布虚空，仙禽神兽随处可见，仙音弥漫，犹如仙境。
这样的君家，林家真的无法比，差的不是一个台阶，而是如隔天地的鸿沟。
“路途遥远奔波，林琅天，我先安排你去休息吧”
一旁的君傲天带着林琅天一边走一边说道；
content_en:
A ray of cyan sword light cut through the sky, cutting through the darkness, allowing Jun Aotian, Lin Langtian and Yi Diao to escape from the dark void.
"Jun Aotian has met the Eighteenth Ancestor"
Seeing an angry green-robed old man in front of him with a majestic aura, a powerful aura, and a large sword in his hand, Jun Aotian quickly saluted.
"Lin Langtian has met the Eighteenth Ancestor." Lin Langtian also followed his example. He couldn't help it. It's not surprising that there are so many people and they are polite.
"Well, Aotian, are you okay?" The old man in green robe glanced sideways at Jun Aotian.
"Eighteenth Ancestor, I'm fine, but I don't know who intercepted us."
Seeing Jun Aotian looking calm and composed, the Eighteenth Patriarch felt relieved.
"The person who took action is a member of the Shi Jue Sect. He can mobilize the killer organization and send the Quasi-Emperor to kill you. Boy Aotian, it seems you have a lot of face."
The old man in green robe had a joking expression.
"Fortunately, the ancestor arrived in time, otherwise we would be in danger. Where are the people from the Shijue Sect?" Jun Aotian expressed his gratitude to the Eighteenth Ancestor.
"As a killer, after one blow, something went wrong, so he naturally retreated. However, no one can touch the Jun family's territory and the Jun family can be safe and sound, but you don't need to worry about it."
"Are you the Lin family boy?" The Eighteen Gods stared at Lin Langtian with lightning eyes.
"Junior Lin Langtian has met the Eighteenth Ancestor." Although the quasi-emperor's momentum is overwhelming and surging, Lin Langtian is as stable as Mount Tai, neither humble nor arrogant.
"Oh, kid, although you are useless now, with your state of mind, you will definitely do something good in the future."
The old man in green robe has admiration in his eyes;
"Thank you for the praise from the Eighteenth Patriarch, I don't deserve it." Lin Langtian pretended to be humble.
"Okay, let's go back to Jun's house and let me take you back to Jun's house."
The Eighteenth Patriarch swung his Daguan Sword, and the void in front of him seemed to be torn apart by a huge force. Then the Eighteenth Patriarch flicked his hand, and the two of them disappeared into the void following the old man in green robes.
The core of the Zhongtian Dao Domain, the Jun Family and the Qitian Palace, symbolize the Jun Family's determination to be higher than the sky. It is indeed the Jun Family that resounds throughout the world and shocks the world.
The Eighteenth Patriarch took the two of them back to Jun's house and then disappeared. Lin Langtian looked at Taoism all over the void, fairy birds and beasts could be seen everywhere, and fairy sounds filled the air, just like a fairyland.
This kind of Jun family is really incomparable to the Lin family. The difference is not a step, but a gap between heaven and earth.
"It's a long journey, Lin Langtian, I'll arrange for you to rest first."
Jun Aotian on the side walked with Lin Langtian and said;
